title: Lazy Agent Service Data State-Flow Graph

stores.purpose: Global request-log rows in the shared prism.requests collection; both insert paths write createdAt equal to timestamp plus toolApiNameCount so every time-based audit reader (trading Monitor, prism-client) sees harness calls (d8a3c10).

Run-scoped state owned by AgentSessionRegistry/ActiveGenerationTracker: tool-call history and fingerprints, per-run scrape budget, known-dead URL map, read-only result reuse, and the activeTools set — pruned together when the run ends (a989f16). Runs survive client disconnect (ADR-10).
Conversation turns and derived fields (appendMessages field builders); the corpus the conversation-embedding service indexes and the loop recalls from.
Durable model completions for the LLMSortObsidian plugin: PUT /obsidian-completions persists the run; GET re-attaches with SSE push of live reasoning, activeTools and deltas (9276e3f).

The shared agent registry (prism.custom_agents): all 34 agents including the trading V3 personas, read directly since prism registration was removed; Canvas persona upserted natively at boot by ClientPersonaSync.

The 78-tool catalog: shards under tool_schemas/<owner_app>/ are the source of truth; scripts/export_tool_schemas.py writes the flat tool_schemas.json and byte-identical trading copies (ADR-02); the runtime cache is filled by ensureSchemas(), which waits for an in-flight fetch (f8c7737).
MCP server registry rows (prism.mcp_servers) for outbound sse/streamable-http connections; stdio rows connect only when the exact command is on MCP_STDIO_COMMANDS (assertStdioAllowed, ADR-06).

External API surface: trading-service tool endpoints (writes gated by the signed _lazy_trading_context and cycle-scoping — synthetic probe cycles get no write tools), the Exa web-search backend, and scraper-service; per-run budgets and tool-budget stops close the run (e5611e9, 02b24a4).
EmbeddingGemma 2 vectors for conversation/memory RAG, produced through the shared Jetson queue (embeddinggemma-2 at 10.0.0.30:8001, batch 1–32) and consumed by memory injection and recall.

OpenTelemetry span batches exported to OTLP http://10.0.0.16:4318 → Tempo :3200 → Grafana :3300; per-tool latency/error metrics and the tool-call spans the trading bridge and search paths attach; /health never traced (ch.07).

flows.label: one audit row per non-/health call, createdAt equal to timestamp
run slot opened on POST /agent, decoupled from the SSE connection
persona + enabledTools lookup for the requested agent
caller turns appended with scoped identity
assistant turns, tool history and derived fields written back
budget counters, dead-URL map, read-only result reuse
memory injection query at prompt assembly
streamed deltas, reasoning and activeTools for SSE re-attach
catalog offer, validation and ensureSchemas refresh
signed-context trading tool calls with budget accounting
Exa search, scrape and /execute fetch behind URL guard and budget
batched EmbeddingGemma 2 writes for conversations and memories
span batches exported per request, tool call and bridge hop
audit rows correlated to their trace for audit readers
